name: Boardgames & Jazz
description: Unwind at the end of the weekend with a relaxed evening of boardgames accompanied by the smooth sounds of live jazz at this cozy cafe.
longDescription:
Boardgames & Jazz is an evening event at LOOK.Sharp Cafe, designed to offer a relaxed conclusion to the weekend. The event combines social tabletop gaming with live musical performance, providing an alternative nightlife option for those seeking a tranquil atmosphere. It aims to foster community interaction through shared activities in a comfortable setting.

Attendees can expect an evening characterized by a calm and inviting ambiance. The event offers the opportunity to engage in various boardgames, from casual to strategic, while enjoying the accompaniment of live jazz music. The cafe setting contributes to an intimate and cozy atmosphere, suitable for both individuals and small groups looking to unwind. The duration of the event is tailored for an evening experience.

The event takes place on 2026-05-10. For ticketing information and entry details, it is advisable to check directly with LOOK.Sharp Cafe. The venue is located in Porto and can be reached via public transport, with specific metro, tram, or bus routes depending on its exact address.
